entities.name: Lark Ojanen
entities.description: A newborn Efravan leonin, child of Pallar and niece of Zar Ojanen, whose birth symbolized hope.

entities.name: Zar Ojanen
entities.description: A warrior among the Efravan, Lark's uncle.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: A dream-interpreting woman who advocated for the Efravans' acceptance in Femeref.

entities.name: Teshunda
entities.description: Magistrate of Femeref who chose to accept the Efravan.

entities.name: Efravan
entities.description: A nomadic leonin tribe fleeing the Phyrexians.

events.summary: The Efravan flee the Great Desert to escape the Phyrexians and seek refuge in Femeref.
events.quote: fled the Great Desert to escape the impending threat of the Phyrexians

events.summary: Teshunda, moved by the newborn Lark, offers the Efravan a place in Femeref.
events.quote: decided to offer them a place within Femeref

relations.quote: the child of Pallar , an Efravan refugee
